mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTR(NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.DEP_ARR_HM), 1, 2) AS HOUR, COUNT(*) AS FLT_CNT, NVL(SUM(GREATEST(NVL(A.BDPSG_CNT, 0) - NVL(A.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, 0), 0)), 0) AS PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{resourceId}, '^FS', '') AND A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' AND A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD != 'D' AND A.TMNL_ID IN (#{terminal}) GROUP BY SUBSTR(NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.DEP_ARR_HM), 1, 2) ORDER BY HOUR

SELECT ISLAND, COUNT(DISTINCT BOOTH_ID) AS BOOTH_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT KIOSK_ID) AS KIOSK_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT SBD_ID) AS BAG_DROP_CNT FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISLAND, A.CKNCT_ID AS BOOTH_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS KIOSK_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS SBD_ID, A.CHKN_OPEN_PRNMNT_DT AS BGN_DT, A.CHKN_CLOSE_PRNMNT_DT AS END_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{caId}, '^CA', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1), NULL, CASE WHEN A.BLCK_ID IN ('P01Self', 'P03Self') THEN A.CKNCT_ID END, CASE WHEN A.BLCK_ID IN ('P01SBD', 'P03SBD') THEN A.CKNCT_ID END, A.OPER_BGNG_DT, A.OPER_END_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{sbdId}, '^SBD', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ) GROUP BY ISLAND ORDER BY ISLAND

SELECT NVL(C.BOOTH_NO, TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.CKNCT_ID, '[^0-9]', ''))) AS BOOTH_NO, MIN(A.ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD, 'N' AS CSTM_ALTMNT_YN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_ATRB A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT K.TMNL_ID, K.CKNCT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY K.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY K.CKNCT_ID) AS BOOTH_NO FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT K WHERE K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND K.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN ('A', 'B') ) C ON C.TMNL_ID = A.TMNL_ID AND C.CKNCT_ID = A.CKNCT_ID WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{caId}, '^CA', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) = #{island} GROUP BY A.CKNCT_ID, C.BOOTH_NO ORDER BY BOOTH_NO

SELECT DISTINCT TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(BGN_DT, 9, 2)) AS OPER_BGNG_HOUR, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(END_DT, 9, 4) = '2359' THEN 24 ELSE TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(END_DT, 9, 2)) END AS OPER_END_HOUR FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISLAND, A.CKNCT_ID AS BOOTH_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS KIOSK_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS SBD_ID, A.CHKN_OPEN_PRNMNT_DT AS BGN_DT, A.CHKN_CLOSE_PRNMNT_DT AS END_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{caId}, '^CA', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1), NULL, CASE WHEN A.BLCK_ID IN ('P01Self', 'P03Self') THEN A.CKNCT_ID END, CASE WHEN A.BLCK_ID IN ('P01SBD', 'P03SBD') THEN A.CKNCT_ID END, A.OPER_BGNG_DT, A.OPER_END_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{sbdId}, '^SBD', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ) WHERE ISLAND = #{island} ORDER BY OPER_BGNG_HOUR, OPER_END_HOUR

SELECT D.GATE_NO AS DPTGT_NO, D.GATE_NO AS DPTGT_NM, 'Y' AS OPR_YN, NVL(MAX(S.FCLTY_CNT), 0) AS SCSH_CNTOM, NVL(MAX(D.GNRL_SRCH_CNTOM), MAX(D.FCLTY_CNT)) AS GNRL_SRCH_CNTOM, NVL(MAX(D.SMART_PASS_SRCH_CNTOM), 0) AS SMART_PASS_SRCH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_ATRB D LEFT JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB S ON S.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{scId}, '^(FOTSC|FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl)', '') AND S.TMNL_ID = D.TMNL_ID AND S.GATE_NO = D.GATE_NO WHERE D.DPTGT_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{depId}, '^(FOTDG|FacilityOpeningTable_DepartureGate)', '') AND D.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} GROUP BY D.GATE_NO ORDER BY D.GATE_NO

SELECT DISTINCT TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(OPER_BGNG_HM, 1, 2)) AS OPER_BGNG_HOUR, CASE WHEN OPER_END_HM = '2359' THEN 24 ELSE TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(OPER_END_HM, 1, 2)) END AS OPER_END_HOUR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_ATRB WHERE DPTGT_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{depId}, '^(FOTDG|FacilityOpeningTable_DepartureGate)', '') AND TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND GATE_NO = #{gateNo} AND OPER_BGNG_HM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OPER_BGNG_HOUR, OPER_END_HOUR
